source_scope.authoritative_document: ODS语兴好物（y shopping）电商数据表.md
source_scope.source_detail_limit: Thirty overview assets have a same-name ODS CREATE. Comment is advertised as _di but created as _df, follows is advertised as follows_di but created as usersfollows_di, and selected ecology audit recreates the community audit table; these three remain physical-name conflicts.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Same-name ODS DDL plus an explicit content, interaction, moderation, messaging, live-commerce, financial or AI-safety semantic profile with authority and privacy boundaries.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Non-empty production full-denominator reconciliation with tenant, source identity, Principal, content/session/case/payment keys, event history, policy/model versions, independently accepted effects and restricted payload controls.

content.grain: one versioned community content aggregate plus immutable publish, edit, visibility, deletion and selection transitions
content.identity: content, author Principal, mentioned Principals, Catalog product, media objects, taxonomy and moderation case identities remain distinct
content.history: denormalized counters and latest audit fields are projections; edits, deletes, visibility and selection decisions append with source version and event time
content.security: body, media URLs, usernames, mentions, location/tool JSON and raw moderation payloads stay tokenized or in restricted storage
content.authority: Community owns content lifecycle; Risk/Moderation owns decisions, Catalog/Listing owns product saleability, and counters never authorize state
corrections: STRING lists and JSON require versioned schemas and element mappings
BIGINT/string timestamps require timezone and source precision
source productid is not a canonical SKU, SPU or Listing without mapping

social_interaction.grain: one immutable comment, reaction, share or relationship command/event; current membership is a separate projection
social_interaction.identity: actor, target author, content, comment, parent/quoted comment and relationship counterpart remain distinct tenant-scoped identities
social_interaction.history: like removal and unfollow rows are deleted from some source snapshots, so those tables cannot reconstruct history without operation/CDC tombstone evidence
social_interaction.security: comment bodies, mentions, images, IP and behavioral identities are restricted and never broad analytical dimensions
social_interaction.authority: an interaction changes only its owned reaction/relationship state; counts are derived and cannot publish, moderate, pay or rank content directly
corrections: require operation type, idempotency key and event time for reversible interactions
resolve _di/_df and follows/usersfollows physical names before ingestion
validate content/comment/Principal mappings and reject orphans

moderation.grain: case, machine observation, human review, appeal, decision and accepted owning-domain effect are separately keyed immutable records
moderation.identity: content/business object, reporter, subject, reviewer, operator, policy, model invocation, audit attempt, appeal and effect identities remain distinct
moderation.history: latest result snapshots never replace audit log, review, appeal, reversal or effect history; deletion retires projections only
moderation.security: published content, reports, reasons, remarks, actor names, IP/media and raw machine JSON remain restricted or tokenized
moderation.authority: machine tags and quality results are signals; reviewed decisions require policy versions, and only the owning service may apply hide, ban, mute, refund or commerce effects
corrections: normalize inconsistent audit/tag/status dictionaries and misspelled fields
require model and policy versions plus accepted-effect causation
separate current case state from append-only audit and appeal histories

messaging_and_search.grain: one immutable message send/delivery attempt or one search observation, never a mutable user profile
messaging_and_search.identity: sender, recipient, message, delivery attempt, search session/query and referenced content/product remain distinct
messaging_and_search.history: send, delivery, read, recall and moderation events append; search observations retain governed purpose and retention windows
messaging_and_search.security: private message bodies, search text, prompts, media, participant identities and inferred intent are highly restricted
messaging_and_search.authority: message/search observations do not prove consent for model training, marketing, user profiling, moderation or commerce actions
corrections: add delivery/read/recall identities instead of inferring success from a row
require explicit processing purpose, consent basis and retention
split community and product search without treating a boolean as canonical taxonomy

live_session.grain: versioned room/session, append-only join/leave/presence and independently versioned product binding
live_session.identity: room, live session/log, host, viewer, product, SKU/SPU, Listing/Offer and moderation case identities remain distinct
live_session.history: room status, presence, product binding and moderation transitions append; current participant/product lists are projections
live_session.security: live URLs, titles, user identities, presence times, comments and media references are restricted
live_session.authority: Community owns live session state; Catalog/Listing owns product identity and saleability, Moderation owns decisions, and presence never proves purchase
corrections: separate room identity from each live session/log
map source product identifiers to exact Listing/Offer
require join/leave pairing, duplicate and late-event rules

live_economy.grain: gift entitlement/claim, recharge payment attempt, tip payment and creator commission accrual/settlement are separate records
live_economy.identity: room/session, giver, receiver/creator, gift definition, entitlement, order, payment attempt, ledger transaction and settlement remain distinct
live_economy.history: authorization, claim, capture, refund, commission accrual, adjustment and settlement append with reversals rather than overwrite
live_economy.security: payer/payee identities, provider references and settlement details are restricted; no raw instrument or credential data is accepted
live_economy.authority: Community records intent/context only; Payment and Ledger own money effects, Order owns entitlement provenance, and approval or gift delivery never proves settlement
corrections: all money requires ISO currency, integer minor unit, rounding and named funder/payee
reconcile recharge, tip and commission to exact Payment/Ledger entries
gift count/value cannot be combined with money without a versioned price and entitlement

ai_red_team.grain: one versioned synthetic persona, generated content/resource or red-team test attempt with model/prompt/scenario lineage
ai_red_team.identity: service account, synthetic persona, scenario, invocation, generated asset, target test subject and reviewed finding remain distinct
ai_red_team.history: prompts, model versions, attempts, generated outputs, findings, review and remediation append; source deletion cannot erase accepted audit history
ai_red_team.security: personas, prompts, generated content/media, attack payloads, credentials and target identifiers remain restricted; secrets stay in a vault
ai_red_team.authority: red-team output is test evidence only and cannot impersonate a real user, publish content, attack production, ban a subject or create commerce effects
corrections: prove synthetic identity and isolated environment for every attempt
bind outputs to immutable model/prompt/scenario versions
require human acceptance and owning-domain remediation references

name_conflict_assets.conflict_rule: Do not equate advertised incremental _di with created full-snapshot _df. Require the physical source, CDC/delete semantics and immutable comment operation identity before credit.
Do not alias follows_di to usersfollows_di. The source removes unfollowed rows, so require tombstones or an operation log before reconstructing relationship history.
The Selected heading recreates the Community audit table and repeats PARTITION/STORED clauses. Require a distinct physical selected source and business key before any alias or detailed credit.
